def Conjecture1735.solutionSet : ℤ → Set (ℤ × ℤ) :=
fun k => {p | p.1 ^ 3 - 2 * p.2 ^ 3 = k}
def Conjecture1735.solutionCount : ℤ → Cardinal.{0} :=
fun k => Cardinal.mk ↑(Conjecture1735.solutionSet k)
def Conjecture1735.MaximumIsTwelve : Prop :=
(∀ (k : ℤ), Conjecture1735.solutionCount k ≤ 12) ∧ ∃ k, Conjecture1735.solutionCount k = 12
def Conjecture1735.Conjecture : Prop :=
Conjecture1735.MaximumIsTwelve ∧ {k | Conjecture1735.solutionCount k = 12}.Finite
def Conjecture1735.NonzeroConjecture : Prop :=
(∀ (k : ℤ), k ≠ 0 → Conjecture1735.solutionCount k ≤ 12) ∧
  (∃ k, k ≠ 0 ∧ Conjecture1735.solutionCount k = 12) ∧ {k | k ≠ 0 ∧ Conjecture1735.solutionCount k = 12}.Finite
Conjecture1735.zero_fiber (x y : ℤ) (h : x ^ 3 - 2 * y ^ 3 = 0) : x = 0 ∧ y = 0
Conjecture1735.solutionCount_zero : Conjecture1735.solutionCount 0 = 1

Conjecture1735.scaled_rhs_injective {k : ℤ} (hk : k ≠ 0) : Function.Injective fun n => (↑n + 1) ^ 3 * k
